The original text '因此，在弹道升弧上，dv/dt < 0，弹丸速度始终减小' (Therefore, on the ascending arc of the trajectory, dv/dt < 0, projectile velocity always decreases) is a clear statement about the behavior of projectile velocity. The source text clearly supports the original structure where '弹丸速度' is the subject and '减小' is the predicate describing its behavior. The revision's rationale mentions 'removing head=tail self-referential binary decrease' but the original was not self-referential - it correctly identified the subject (projectile velocity) and its property (decreasing). The evidence bundle confirms the source text supports the original interpretation, not the proposed revision.
